records.name: (no feed configured)
records.reason: https://api.actransit.org/transit/gtfs/download returns HTTP 401 "A valid API token is required to use the AC Transit API" (checked 2026-09-04, and re-confirmed the same day on a spaced-out retry rather than inside the fetch burst). The older catalog row points at the retired transitfeeds.com aggregator. This project does not hold agency API credentials and will not fetch a feed it cannot fetch anonymously, so AC Transit fare rows stay uncross-checked. A standing condition, not a transient failure: an API-token requirement does not come and go.

records.name: (no feed configured)
records.reason: No first-party Elk Grove GTFS feed found (checked 2026-09-04, and re-confirmed the same day on a spaced-out retry). The Mobility Database's active row, https://elkgrovetransit.com/gtfs, 302s to an unrelated commercial site on another domain; every path on that host does, on both attempts. SacRT, which operates e-tran and publishes the prose corpus for it, serves a GTFS feed with no fare table at all. A standing condition: a domain that resolves somewhere else is not a load artifact.

records.name: (no feed configured)
records.reason: https://www.sacrt.com/wp-content/uploads/google_transit.zip downloads a valid 2.7 MB GTFS ZIP (11 members) that contains neither fare_attributes.txt nor fare_products.txt; the older iportal.sacrt.com row serves a different 2.3 MB ZIP with the same absence (checked 2026-09-04, both re-confirmed the same day on a spaced-out retry). There is nothing to cross-check against the prose until SacRT publishes fare data in its feed. A structural absence rather than a fetch failure: the download succeeds.

records.name: (no feed configured)
records.reason: Yolobus's own GTFS page links one feed, https://avl.yctd.org/RealTime/google_transit.zip, and it downloads a valid 485 KB ZIP (7 members) that contains no fare file. The Mobility Database's direct_download for Yolobus, yolobus.com/GTFS/google_transit.zip, 404s. Checked 2026-09-04 and both re-confirmed the same day on a spaced-out retry, honouring yolobus.com's Crawl-delay of 10. Same outcome as SacRT for a different reason, and structural the same way: the download succeeds, the fares are not in it.
